principle: MiMo may explain approved candidates; model output cannot rewrite facts or bypass Core.

roles.laya: Optional source-navigation/choice adapter after EVREN compatibility validation.
roles.mimo: Optional reasoning/chat adapter after access, privacy and schema validation.

tool_output.selected: array of approved IDs, source URLs, hashes and factual caveats

output_validation: kepcore.core.check_model_selection rejects IDs outside the Core-approved set. This is an ID guard, NOT a complete free-text factuality or prompt-injection defense.
